note: Candidates for the bad group, researched 2026-11-07. Each source URL names the token contract and documents the scam. Every address is checked on-chain (an ERC-20 contract whose symbol matches the source) before it becomes a case. 'exclude' marks a candidate kept for the record but not used. 'Detector-only label' in evidence means the only source that prints the address is the honeypot.is detector.

candidates.name: PayPal USD
candidates.evidence: Webacy lists it among fake PYUSD tokens issued after PayPal's launch: oddly low holder count, flagged as blacklisted. eventAt is pair creation (honeypot.is).

candidates.name: PayPal USD

candidates.name: PYUSD

candidates.name: GROK 2.0

candidates.name: Gemini
candidates.evidence: CertiK lists 'Fake Gemini' as an example of bot-driven wash-trading exit scams that end with the liquidity pool drained.

candidates.name: GROKAI

candidates.name: Mooon

candidates.name: XDOGE

candidates.name: Tommi
candidates.evidence: CertiK: a malicious backdoor in openTrading let the rug puller take tokens from the pool and dump them (about 3.95 ETH). eventAt is the report date; pair created 2024-05-07.

candidates.name: WIZ
candidates.evidence: Check Point: the scammer deployed WIZ, then used a backdoor to burn WIZ in the pool, inflating the price 22,000% and selling for $80,000.

candidates.name: Safereum

candidates.name: NOVAMIND_

candidates.name: Ora AI

candidates.name: FSL
